title: ACAT TTS Engine Settings
description: Configuration for text-to-speech (TTS) engines in ACAT - maps languages to their preferred TTS engine

ttsEngines.description: List of preferred TTS engine mappings per language

ttsEngineEntry.description: Mapping of a language to its preferred TTS engine

language.description: Language code (ISO 639-1 two-letter code, optionally with region)

id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the preferred TTS engine for this language. Use '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' for the default/null engine.

ttsGlobalSettings.description: Global settings controlling TTS engine behavior

rate.description: Speech rate. Typical range depends on the TTS engine; SAPI uses -10 to 10.

pitch.description: Speech pitch. Typical range depends on the TTS engine; SAPI uses -10 to 10.

voiceName.description: Name of the preferred voice to use (engine-specific). Empty string uses the engine default.

speakOnFocusChange.description: Automatically speak the focused element text when focus changes

speakOnHighlight.description: Speak the widget text when it is highlighted during scanning
